notes: Re-adjudicated by kb/Work PB5844, on the contingency kb/Work PB5373 class 3 named ("re-adjudicate if a method for the clause is ever provided"). §1985:VII.2.8.4 GR6 asks that for an external file connector "all RECORD DELIMITER clauses in the run unit which are associated with that file connector must have the same specifications", beside §1985:VII.2.3.4 GR1 c's "consistent specification for implementor-name-2" whose consistency rules the implementor specifies. The clause now specifies a method: BINARY-SEQUENTIAL the record sequential length prefix, LINE-SEQUENTIAL the line sequential file's line delimiter (docs/CONFORMANCE.md DOC-A.1-150), and STANDARD-1 is declined as a reel-device element (§1985:I.1.5.2.5.1, §2 row 26), leaving the length prefix in force. The entries are compared on the method they specify (FileEntryIdentity.Segments, its DELIM segment; DOC-A.1-149), at compile time through COBOL6847, whose message cites this rule at --std 85 (ExternalFileConnectorRules.Check), and at run time through the external-file mismatch check: two entries whose clauses select different methods disagree, and an omitted clause, BINARY-SEQUENTIAL and the declined STANDARD-1 agree (kb/Work PB5311). ExternalFileEntryIdentityTests pins both; the 1985 case pb5311-external-reserve-and-delimiter-defaults runs the agreement across two programs at --std 85. retired-witness: conformance-test:DocumentedNonSupportWitnessTests.RecordDelimiterFeatureName_NamedNonSupportWarning_PinnedToSpec (kb/Work PB5844 provides the implementor-names, so the test that pinned the clause's whole decline is deleted)

next.reason: 1985 RECORD DELIMITER GR6: for an external file connector 'all RECORD DELIMITER clauses in the run unit which are associated with that file connector must have the same specifications'. 1985 file control GR1c ('consistent specification for implementor-name-2 ... The implementor will specify the consistency rules') binds alongside it, so 1985 required both identity and consistency. 2023 keeps only §2023:12.4.5.3 GR1c 'Either the STANDARD-1 phrase or a consistent value of feature-name-1 in the RECORD DELIMITER clause. The implementor shall specify the consistency rules for feature-name-1' (documented per §2023:A.1, RECORD DELIMITER consistency rules); the RECORD DELIMITER clause rules of §2023:12.4.5.11.4 state no sameness requirement. Different but consistent feature-names now conform: looser.
